S&P 500 futures +0.7% and Nvidia -5.4% before the bell; Friday's Nasdaq rose 1.09%.

Yahoo Finance futures quotes: Dow +1.05%, S&P 500 +0.71%, Nasdaq +0.60%. The quote time is not stated. An earlier report (3:42 AM ET) showed smaller gains.

Nvidia fell in premarket trading; no confirmed business cause in our sources. Alphabet rose about 3% after unveiling new TPU AI chips.
